baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative descent, source construction, liquid object, and intensive outflow modifier in 78:14.
baseline_models.mechanism: An agent transfers literal water from a rain-loaded atmospheric source to a lower destination, where the transfer manifests as high-volume discharge.

activation_trace.role: Caused sending and delivery make agency and transfer, rather than spontaneous falling, the governing action.
The rain-bearing cloud or wind image supplies a loaded atmospheric source.
Ordinary water fixes the transferred material as literal water.
Pouring and outflow supply the forceful discharge at the transfer endpoint.

changed_reading.after: Water is deliberately delivered from a loaded upper source as a forceful hydraulic transfer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of the compressing-source expression and the intensive outflow adjective.
baseline_models.mechanism: The source behaves like material pressed until retained liquid is extracted; pressure, abundance, and outflow form a storage-to-release mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Pressure until liquid is expressed supplies the storage-and-extraction stage.
Water appearing in abundance supplies the released volume.
Outflow converts retained volume into an active stream.

changed_reading.before: The final adjective only says the rain is heavy.
changed_reading.after: The heaviness is the release phase of a pressurized source, not an isolated intensity label.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The caused descent of water together with an outflow term that also names a basin-filled meadow.
baseline_models.mechanism: Water is not merely moved downward; it is put where watering can occur, with outflow terminating in receptive ground and basins.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its proper place turns descent into destination-sensitive placement.
Supplying water by pouring gives the descent an irrigation function.
The meadow-with-basins image supplies a receiving landscape for the outflow.

changed_reading.before: Rain is viewed from the skyward source alone.
changed_reading.after: The verse spans source, routed delivery, and receptive ground as one irrigation event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The caused delivery of water, read through the descent root's prepared-provision branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The descending water can be carried as provision prepared for inhabitants or arrivals, making rainfall an act of material hospitality.

activation_trace.role: Prepared guest-provision recasts descent as hosted supply.
Water supplied by pouring identifies the substance of the provision.
Abundant outflow makes the provision publicly available rather than hoarded.

changed_reading.before: Rain is an impersonal natural input.
changed_reading.after: Rain is provision actively prepared and delivered for those received into a place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The source term's recurring-time branch and the descent root's single-episode branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The outpour is a bounded release episode nested within recurring time rather than an undifferentiated continuous state.

activation_trace.role: Recurring age or time supplies a periodic frame for the source.
One descent or episode bounds the release as an occurrence.
The outflow is the event that fills the bounded interval.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts generic rainfall without temporal articulation.
changed_reading.after: It depicts a discrete outpouring episode within a recurrent schedule.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole construction sequence turns rain into the conversion node between an arranged upper source and biological emergence: made conditions lead to delivered water, then hidden seed exits as growth and enclosed garden.

activation_trace.role: Proper placement makes the water a fitted input in a larger arrangement.
Watering and pouring supply the transfer stage that can feed growth.
The basin-filled meadow image links discharge to a productive receiving surface.
Making something assume a state supplies the deliberate system-setting immediately before rain.
Bringing something out of concealment makes emergence the direct downstream operation.
The germinating grain identifies a compact latent payload activated by water.
Plant growth from earth supplies the visible conversion product.
A garden enclosed by trees supplies the mature, accumulated endpoint.

structural_cues: The coordinated sequence 78:6-16 moves from prepared ground and upper structure through lamp and rain to grain, vegetation, and gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrangement, watering, emergence, grain, plants, and gardens; I infer a causal conversion chain through 78:14. A live alternative is a list of adjacent signs without one engineered process.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a self-contained weather sign.
changed_reading.after: It is the central transfer operation in a designed life-production chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Compression in the focus source is sharpened by batch-like water above and by later outlet and gate imagery, yielding a reservoir-pressure-aperture-discharge model.

activation_trace.role: Pressure that expresses liquid supplies the retained-energy stage.
Forceful outflow supplies the release stage.
The branch image of clouds releasing water in batches sharpens discharge as pulsed rather than undifferentiated.
Water issuing from an opened outlet supplies a valve-like aperture.
An entrance or gate turns the upper boundary into a traversable threshold.

structural_cues: A strong upper structure is built in 78:12, while 78:19 later depicts the sky opened into gates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, water batches, an outlet, and gates; I infer a pressure-and-valve architecture. The alternative is that the later opening belongs only to eschatological rupture and does not model ordinary rain.

changed_reading.before: Compressed clouds simply let rain fall.
changed_reading.after: Stored water is released in pulses through thresholds in an upper architecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes copiousness from transgression: destructive water crosses a limit, whereas correspondence and sufficiency indicate fitted measure. The focus torrent is therefore intense yet placed within a productive bound.

activation_trace.role: Proper placement keeps the abundant delivery fitted to its destination.
The torrent supplies the intensity whose boundary status is being tested.
Water rising with sweeping force supplies the image of abundance that has crossed its limit.
An amount equal to need or counterpart supplies calibrated fit.
Sufficiency supplies the positive limit against uncontrolled excess.

structural_cues: Productive abundance in 78:14-16 is later set against transgression, corresponding recompense, and sufficient gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a water-overflow image under transgression plus matching and sufficiency; I transfer that boundary logic back to the torrent. The alternative is that the intensive adjective intentionally leaves quantity unbounded.

changed_reading.before: The stronger the downpour, the more complete its meaning.
changed_reading.after: Its force is productive because abundance is delivered within fit, unlike force that crosses a bound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus water becomes the usable baseline in a surah-wide sorting of liquids: life-producing supply, aversive hot or exuding punishment-fluid, and a reward cup filled to its limit.

activation_trace.role: Supplied water establishes the beneficial liquid baseline.
Outflow supplies a neutral transport pattern whose contents and endpoint can vary.
Water consumed with aversion marks liquid that fails the ordinary function of refreshment.
Hot water supplies a punitive inversion of the focus supply.
Flowing and exudation preserve the focus outflow pattern while reversing its value.
A cup filled to its top supplies the positive, contained completion of liquid abundance.

structural_cues: The focus water produces life in 78:15-16; 78:24-25 denies cooling drink; 78:34 presents a full cup.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several liquid states and outcomes; I organize them as one distribution contrast centered on the focus water. The alternative is that the later drinks are independent reward and punishment images.

changed_reading.before: The water is one beneficial object in the creation list.
changed_reading.after: It is the reference liquid against which later fluids are sorted by usability, containment, and destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The guest-provision branch of descent expands into destination-specific hosting: creatures receive common water now, while return-sites later disclose corresponding recompense or nurturing gift.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for an arrival supplies the hospitality frame.
Watering identifies present-world provision in that frame.
Return to a destination supplies the arrival-site at which provision takes its final form.
Response corresponding to action makes later provision destination-specific rather than common.
Nurturing, repair, and completion give the host role a developmental function.
Handing over a gift supplies the explicit provision transaction.

structural_cues: The latter half distinguishes return-sites and then describes recompense and gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prepared provision, return, recompense, nurture, and gift; I infer one hosting economy across present rain and final destinations. The alternative is that the descent branch's hospitality sense is inactive here.

changed_reading.before: Rain is provision without a recipient-role or destination logic.
changed_reading.after: Rain is present hospitality that anticipates differentiated provision when recipients return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Real water descends and changes the ground, while a later solid mountain becomes a water-like appearance. The focus becomes a benchmark of effective liquidity against visually convincing but materially ineffective liquidity.

activation_trace.role: Literal water establishes the real material term of the contrast.
Actual outflow gives the real water observable causal force.
Seeping and dripping water supplies the material behavior evoked by the later image.
A mirage shining like water supplies the ineffective visual counterpart.

structural_cues: After real rain produces vegetation, 78:20 makes mountains become mirage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal outflow plus seepage and mirage branches under the mountain reversal; I infer a real-versus-apparent liquidity contrast. The alternative is that the mirage only marks mountain disappearance.

changed_reading.before: Water is simply one material among the created signs.
changed_reading.after: Its productive material reality becomes the standard by which a later water-like appearance is exposed as nonproductive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later root whose branches join rain descending and settling with correctness activates a double precision in the focus: the water both comes down and lands where it is right for it to settle.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its proper place makes descent a placement operation.
Outflow is the moving material that must reach and settle at a destination.
Rain descending from above and settling directly reactivates the focus motion.
Correctness opposite error supplies the fitted-destination value of that motion.

structural_cues: In 78:38 the context occurrence describes authorized right speech, not rainfall, making the branch convergence cross-domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root with rain-settling and correctness branches; I infer that correct landing sharpens the focus delivery. The alternative is accidental polysemy with no backward activation.

changed_reading.before: Sending down specifies only vertical direction.
changed_reading.after: Sending down also implies successful placement: the water reaches the fitting place and settles there.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's recurring-time and single-descent branches are amplified by a bounded day, a fixed appointment, and return at sunset, making the rain episode one timed release within an ordered recurrence that also has a final appointment.

activation_trace.role: Recurring time gives the source a periodic orientation.
A single descent supplies the bounded event within recurrence.
A delimited duration supplies a larger bounded temporal unit.
A fixed appointment supplies determined timing rather than random occurrence.
Sunset returning to its destination supplies a cyclic return image.

structural_cues: The surah first coordinates sleep, night, and day, then names the Day of Separation as an appointment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, a single episode, bounded duration, appointment, and return; I infer a scheduled-release pattern spanning natural cycles and the final day. The alternative is that the time branch of the focus noun is inactive.

changed_reading.before: The torrent is spatially directed but temporally generic.
changed_reading.after: It is a timed episode in a recurring order that trains perception for a uniquely appointed event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places divine downward delivery beside what human hands send forward. Rain becomes an entrusted input: provision arrives from above, while transformed human outputs are deposited ahead for later inspection.

activation_trace.role: Caused delivery supplies the divine input direction.
Water supplied for use identifies the entrusted material input.
Advancing something forward supplies the human output direction.
What the two hands acquire identifies human agency and responsibility for the output.

structural_cues: The focus uses first-person causative agency for provision, while 78:40 closes with a person seeing what the hands sent ahead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies downward divine delivery and forward human production; I infer an input-accountability relation. The alternative is that the two directional acts are rhetorically separate.

changed_reading.before: The water only demonstrates divine power and supports vegetation.
changed_reading.after: The delivered water is also an entrusted input whose human use belongs to the output later inspected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates bodily-fluid branches rather than ordinary meteorology. It remains anchored in the focus descent and water terms and is reinforced by created pairing and germination, but downstream prose must present it only as a fecundity analogy, never as a replacement for literal rain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The descent root's emitted-fluid branch, the water root's reproductive-fluid branch, and the torrent's outflow branch.

activation_trace.role: Emitted male fluid supplies a bodily analogue for caused liquid release.
Fluid deposited in a womb supplies the fecundating destination.
Outflow supplies the shared release motion without changing water into another substance.
Joining one thing as the counterpart of another supplies the paired reproductive frame.
Causing seed and planting to grow supplies the generative result.

changed_reading.after: At an analogical level, the liquid release fecundates receptive ground so latent life can emerge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain and surprising because a physical torrent is activated by branches of eloquence, speech, and correctness. It remains anchored in the focus outflow adjective and the later root's rain-descent branch, but prose must describe an enacted analogy and must not claim that the focus water lexically means speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outflow adjective's eloquent-speaker branch while the noun still explicitly denotes water.

activation_trace.role: The eloquent speaker image gives fluent abundance a speech-domain analogue.
Intelligible utterance connecting speakers supplies articulated release.
Speech brought out through voicing supplies an authorized emission.
Rain descending and settling unexpectedly loops the right-speech context back to the focus event.

changed_reading.before: The torrent only quantifies physical water.
changed_reading.after: The physical downpour can also enact the pattern of permitted right utterance: fluent release that descends and lands effectively.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the non-dominant mapped root behind the opening question, so it is especially mapping-distant. Its smooth-flow and valley-channel images remain visibly anchored to the focus pressure and torrent, but downstream prose must label the result speculative and not derive the question's ordinary lexical meaning from the non-dominant mapping.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pressure-to-outflow construction in the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Compression supplies the build-up before an answer-like release.
Torrent outflow supplies the material answer-flow.
The non-dominant mapping's smooth-flow image gives questioning a flow-shaped activation.
A watercourse through a valley supplies a channel for that release.
News that arrives and is conveyed supplies the answer-like payload.

changed_reading.before: The rain sign is separate from the surah's opening inquiry.
changed_reading.after: Speculatively, the opening question builds pressure and the created sign embodies an answer extracted, channeled, and delivered in flow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the final unbeliever term through its seed-covering branch and joins it to the wish for dust. It remains anchored in the focus water's immediately stated germination effect, but prose must not claim that the context noun literally denotes a seed; it may only expose the covered-seed reversal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The supplied torrent whose explicit next result is grain and plant emergence.

activation_trace.role: Water supplied by pouring is the activating input for buried life.
Plant emergence from earth supplies the observable reversal of concealment.
Covering seed supplies a latent-life image under the final human designation.
Dust and earth supply the medium in which covered seed can be hidden.

changed_reading.before: Rain producing plants is only an ordinary creation sign.
changed_reading.after: The torrent also makes the final wish for dust unstable: water has already shown that covered life can emerge from earth.

strongest_changes: The ayah shifted from isolated weather to the central transfer operation in a ground-to-garden life-production chain.
Pressure, batch, outlet, and gate cues sharpened the rain into a controlled storage-and-release mechanism.
Later punitive and rewarded drinks turned the focus water into the usable baseline of a sorted liquid economy.
The correctness/rain branch convergence changed descent from mere downward motion into delivery that lands in a fitting place.
The final human-hands construction recast supplied water as an entrusted input connected to accountable outputs.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated distant reversals that a narrow growth pericope would miss: upper gates, mountain-mirage liquidity, hostile and rewarded fluids, right speech that loops back to rain, and the covered-seed image at the final wish for dust.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the pressure-extraction branch should govern the atmospheric source or remain secondary to the direct rain-cloud branch.
Whether the right-speech, rain-settling, and eloquent-outflow convergence reflects a live cross-domain mechanism or only branch polysemy.
Whether guest-provision, timed episode, and fecundating-emission models are intended latent structures or useful but distant analogies.
Whether the non-dominant question-root flow activation is semantically productive beyond this exploratory trace.
